rx_supported_single_leg_stance.cues: Lightly hold a counter, lift one foot a little and stand tall on the other leg, then switch.

rx_band_clamshell.name: Band clamshell
rx_band_clamshell.cues: Lie on your side with a band above the knees, open the top knee in the pain-free range, lower slowly.

rx_seated_band_abduction.name: Seated band knee-out
rx_seated_band_abduction.cues: Sit with a band around the knees, push them apart in the pain-free range and return slowly.

rx_high_box_squat.name: High box squat
rx_high_box_squat.cues: Sit back to a high chair or box, tap it lightly and stand up, depth only as far as pain-free.

rx_supported_squat_hold.name: Supported squat hold
rx_supported_squat_hold.cues: Hold a door frame or counter, sit down into a comfortable squat depth and hold, heels down.

rx_high_wall_sit.name: High wall sit
rx_high_wall_sit.cues: Back against a wall, slide down only a little to a pain-free bend and hold, knees over feet.

rx_spanish_squat_hold.name: Band Spanish squat hold
rx_spanish_squat_hold.cues: Heavy band behind the knees anchored in front, sit back with shins upright to a pain-free depth and hold.

rx_split_squat_hold.name: Supported split squat hold
rx_split_squat_hold.cues: Hold a support, staggered stance, lower a little to a pain-free bend and hold, front knee over foot.

rx_terminal_knee_extension_hold.name: Band knee lock-out hold
rx_terminal_knee_extension_hold.cues: Band behind the knee anchored in front, straighten the knee against it and hold, thigh tight.

rx_seated_knee_extension_hold.name: Seated leg straight hold
rx_seated_knee_extension_hold.cues: Sit tall, straighten one knee as far as comfortable, tighten the thigh and hold, then lower.

rx_straight_leg_raise.name: Straight leg raise
rx_straight_leg_raise.cues: Lie on your back, other knee bent, tighten the thigh and lift the straight leg to knee height, lower slowly.

rx_short_arc_quad.name: Short arc knee straighten
rx_short_arc_quad.cues: Lie with a rolled towel under the knee, straighten the lower leg fully, hold a second, lower slowly.

rx_low_step_up.name: Low step-up
rx_low_step_up.cues: Hold a rail, step up onto a low step with the whole foot, stand tall, and step down slowly.

rx_iso_ankle_dorsiflexion.name: Isometric ankle pull-up
rx_iso_ankle_dorsiflexion.cues: Seated, put the other heel on top of your foot and try to pull the toes up against it; hold.

rx_iso_ankle_plantarflexion.name: Isometric ankle push-down
rx_iso_ankle_plantarflexion.cues: Seated, press the ball of your foot into a wall or firm surface without moving, and hold.

rx_iso_ankle_inversion.name: Isometric ankle turn-in
rx_iso_ankle_inversion.cues: Seated, press the inside of your foot against the other foot or a chair leg and hold gently.

rx_iso_ankle_eversion.name: Isometric ankle turn-out
rx_iso_ankle_eversion.cues: Seated, press the outside of your foot against a wall or chair leg and hold gently.

rx_calf_raise_hold.name: Supported calf raise hold
rx_calf_raise_hold.cues: Hold a support, rise onto the balls of your feet to a comfortable height and hold.

rx_seated_calf_press_hold.name: Seated heel lift hold
rx_seated_calf_press_hold.cues: Sit tall, lift both heels with hands pressing down on your knees, and hold.

rx_band_ankle_dorsiflexion.name: Band ankle pull-up
rx_band_ankle_dorsiflexion.cues: Seated, band anchored in front around the foot, pull the toes up in the pain-free range, return slowly.

rx_band_ankle_plantarflexion.name: Band ankle push
rx_band_ankle_plantarflexion.cues: Seated, band around the ball of the foot, push the foot down in the pain-free range, return slowly.

rx_partial_calf_raise.name: Partial calf raise
rx_partial_calf_raise.cues: Hold a support and lift the heels only a little, in the pain-free range, then lower slowly.

br_belly_breathing.name: Belly breathing
br_belly_breathing.cues: Hand on your belly; breathe in through the nose so it rises, and breathe out slowly through the mouth.

br_long_exhale.name: Long exhale breathing
br_long_exhale.cues: Breathe in for 4 counts and out for 6 to 8 counts, never holding your breath.

br_side_rib_breathing.name: Rib breathing
br_side_rib_breathing.cues: Hands on your lower ribs; breathe in to widen them sideways, then let them close as you breathe out.

br_lying_relax.name: Lying calm breathing
br_lying_relax.cues: Lie on your back with knees bent and breathe slowly, letting your shoulders and jaw relax.

kid_balloon_breathing.name: Balloon breathing
kid_balloon_breathing.cues: Breathe in slowly to fill a big imaginary balloon, then let the air out gently.

cw_slow_walk_room.name: Slow walk around the room
cw_slow_walk_room.cues: Walk slowly and easily, letting your breathing settle.

cw_slow_step_touch.name: Slow step touch
cw_slow_step_touch.cues: Step side to side slowly, swinging the arms softly, and breathe easy.

cw_easy_bike.name: Easy bike spin
cw_easy_bike.cues: Pedal with light resistance at an easy pace to bring your heart rate down.

cw_seated_slow_march.name: Seated slow march
cw_seated_slow_march.cues: Sitting tall, lift one knee a little, then the other, slowly, breathing easy.

cw_arm_swing_walk.name: Walk with easy arm swings
cw_arm_swing_walk.cues: Walk at a relaxed pace and let the arms swing loosely.

fc_fast_march.name: Fast march
fc_fast_march.cues: March quickly in place, pumping the arms, keeping one foot on the floor.

fc_shadow_boxing.name: Shadow boxing
fc_shadow_boxing.cues: Stand with soft knees and throw light, quick punches, staying on the balls of your feet.

fc_low_impact_jacks.name: Low-impact jacks
fc_low_impact_jacks.cues: Step one foot out while raising the arms, then step back in, alternating sides quickly.

fc_step_touch_fast.name: Quick step touch
fc_step_touch_fast.cues: Step side to side at a brisk pace, adding arm reaches.

fc_skater_steps.name: Skater steps (no jump)
fc_skater_steps.cues: Step wide to one side and bring the other foot behind, then switch, swinging the arms.

fc_seated_punches.name: Seated fast punches
fc_seated_punches.cues: Sitting tall, punch forward quickly with alternating arms, breathing steadily.

fc_seated_fast_march.name: Seated fast march
fc_seated_fast_march.cues: Sitting tall, march your feet quickly and pump the arms.

fc_seated_jacks.name: Seated jacks
fc_seated_jacks.cues: Sitting, tap the feet out to the sides while raising the arms, then back in.

fc_rowing_machine_easy.name: Rowing machine intervals
fc_rowing_machine_easy.cues: Row with long smooth strokes: 30 s steady, 30 s easy, legs first then arms.

fc_bike_intervals.name: Bike intervals
fc_bike_intervals.cues: Pedal 30 s a little harder, then 30 s easy, staying tall on the seat.

wu_seated_arm_swings.name: Seated arm swings
wu_seated_arm_swings.cues: Sitting tall, swing both arms forward and back loosely, getting a little faster.

wu_seated_step_outs.name: Seated step-outs
wu_seated_step_outs.cues: Sitting, step one foot out to the side and back, then the other, in a steady rhythm.

wu_seated_heel_toe_taps_rhythm.name: Seated heel-toe taps
wu_seated_heel_toe_taps_rhythm.cues: Sitting, tap heels then toes quickly on the floor, adding arm swings.

seated_palm_press.name: Seated palm press
seated_palm_press.cues: Sit tall, press your palms together in front of your chest for 5 s, then relax; repeat.

seated_high_palm_press.name: Seated high palm press
seated_high_palm_press.cues: Sitting, press the palms together at eye level, elbows soft, for 5 s; repeat.

seated_low_palm_press.name: Seated low palm press
seated_low_palm_press.cues: Sitting, press the palms together low in front of your belly for 5 s; repeat.

seated_hug_squeeze.name: Seated big hug
seated_hug_squeeze.cues: Sitting, round the arms as if hugging a big ball and squeeze for 10 s.

seated_towel_press_up.name: Seated towel press, angled up
seated_towel_press_up.cues: Hold a towel stretched between both hands at chest height, angled up, and pull it apart-hard while pressing forward.

seated_elbow_drive.name: Seated elbow drive
seated_elbow_drive.cues: Sitting tall, pull the elbows back and squeeze the shoulder blades for 3 s; repeat.

seated_w_squeeze.name: Seated W squeeze
seated_w_squeeze.cues: Sitting, arms in a W beside you, press the elbows down and back and hold 5 s.

seated_towel_row_hold.name: Seated towel row hold
seated_towel_row_hold.cues: Loop a towel around your feet, sit tall and pull it toward you, squeezing the back for 10 s.

seated_arms_back_lift.name: Seated reverse fly (no weight)
seated_arms_back_lift.cues: Lean forward slightly, arms hanging, lift them out to the sides to shoulder height, and lower slowly.

cw_seated_arm_float.name: Seated slow arm float
cw_seated_arm_float.cues: Sitting, float the arms up in front to shoulder height and down, slowly, with calm breathing.

cw_seated_ankle_pumps.name: Seated easy ankle pumps
cw_seated_ankle_pumps.cues: Sitting, slowly point and flex both feet while your breathing settles.

cw_seated_shoulder_circles_slow.name: Seated slow shoulder circles
cw_seated_shoulder_circles_slow.cues: Sitting tall, roll the shoulders slowly backward in big circles.

fc_seated_twist_taps.name: Seated twist taps
fc_seated_twist_taps.cues: Sitting tall, twist and tap the opposite knee with each hand, quickly and steadily.

fc_seated_heel_drums.name: Seated heel drums
fc_seated_heel_drums.cues: Sitting, drum the heels quickly on the floor while pumping the arms.

fc_seated_reach_ups.name: Seated fast reach-ups
fc_seated_reach_ups.cues: Sitting, reach up with alternating arms at a steady, quick pace.

seated_incline_towel_squeeze.name: Seated towel squeeze, arms high
seated_incline_towel_squeeze.cues: Hold a rolled towel between the palms at eye level and squeeze it for 10 s.

seated_diagonal_press.name: Seated diagonal press
seated_diagonal_press.cues: Sitting, press one palm up and across against the other hand for 5 s; switch sides.

squat.name: Sit-to-stand (30 s)
squat.how: Sit on a chair, arms crossed. Stand up fully and sit back down as many times as you can in 30 seconds. Count each full stand.

single_leg_balance.name: Single-leg balance
single_leg_balance.how: Stand on one leg, hands on hips, eyes open. Time how long you hold before the other foot touches down. Then the other leg.

glute_bridge_hold.name: Glute bridge hold
glute_bridge_hold.how: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat. Lift your hips into a straight line from knees to shoulders and hold.

front_plank.name: Front plank
front_plank.how: Forearms and toes on the floor, body straight from head to heels. Hold without letting the hips sag.

shoulder_reach.name: Overhead shoulder reach
shoulder_reach.how: Stand with your back against a wall. Raise one straight arm overhead. Can the back of your hand touch the wall without arching your back? Then the other arm.

repair.safety: Stop if anything hurts. For balance tests, stand next to a wall or a sturdy chair.

movementPain.title: Which movements hurt?
movementPain.intro: We don't diagnose. We map which movements hurt, so your workouts keep the ones that don't.
movementPain.childGate: Do this with your parent or guardian.
movementPain.childConfirm: A parent or guardian is with me
movementPain.stopBody: What you ticked should be checked by a doctor or physical therapist before training this area. We won't build a plan, and your workouts leave this area out for now.
movementPain.moveBody: Try each one gently, only if it feels safe. Leave "Not tried" when unsure.
movementPain.untriedNote: Movements not tried are treated as painful, to be safe.
movementPain.needPainful: Mark at least one movement that hurts.
movementPain.scoreTitle: How strong is the pain, at its worst?
movementPain.disclaimer: TapStrong adapts training; it doesn't diagnose. Sharp or lasting pain? See a doctor or physical therapist.
movementPain.underReview: This feature is being reviewed by a certified coach. It will appear here soon.
movementPain.devOnly: Development build: draft movement list, not reviewed yet. It never reaches users.

phases.1: Calm it down: gentle holds and pain-free range.
phases.2: Strengthen: build strength in the pain-free range.
phases.3: Progress: more range and load, step by step.

plan.lightRule: 0–3 green: moving on. 4–5 yellow: staying. Over 5, or clearly worse the next morning: red, one step back.
plan.noLights: Rate the pain after each workout and the next morning.
plan.seePTBody: Your pain hasn't improved in 3 weeks, or it got worse. A physical therapist can find the cause; TapStrong can support the plan they give you.

check.morning: {{area}}: how does it feel this morning?

retest.title: Weekly retest
retest.body: Do each movement gently, only as far as it's comfortable, and rate the pain.

entry.body: Build a recovery plan around the movements that hurt, and keep training the rest.
